cs.t:
I used a standing desk for a long time (year+). I recommend minimalist shoes, this will help your feet get stronger, stay away from anything that has cushion in it. Lately, I got these:  http://naturalfootgear.com/collections/mens-shoes/products/l...  
Can't recommend them enough.
cs.th: Ask HN: Standing Desk Folks – What shoes do you wear?
